findings.explanation: The wildcard branch returns the same ARB for every non-Refv input. Lean therefore proves that dest_Refv takes equal values on W8array [] and Varray [] at result type Bool. HOL4 specifies only the Refv equation and permits those two inputs to return different Booleans.
findings.repair:
private axiom dest_Refv_other {α : Type} [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α

def dest_Refv [Nonempty α] : store_v α → α
  | Refv v => v
  | s => dest_Refv_other s
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps
open CmlTS
example : dest_Refv (store_v.W8array [] : store_v Bool) = dest_Refv (store_v.Varray [] : store_v Bool) := rfl

findings.explanation: The wildcard branch assigns one ARB set to all Dmod, Dlocal, and Denv declarations. For example, Lean proves that Dlocal [] [] and Denv n have equal free-variable sets for every n. HOL4's five equations leave both values open.
findings.repair:
private axiom FV_dec_other : dec → Set (ident modN varN)

def FV_dec : dec → Set (ident modN varN)
  | Dlet _ p e => FV (exp.Mat e [(p, exp.Lit ARB)])
  | Dletrec _ defs => FV (exp.Letrec defs (exp.Lit ARB))
  | Dtype _ _ => ∅
  | Dtabbrev _ _ _ _ => ∅
  | Dexn _ _ _ => ∅
  | d => FV_dec_other d
findings.lean_check:
import CmlTS.SemanticPrimitivesProps
open CmlTS
example (n : tvarN) : FV_dec (dec.Dlocal [] []) = FV_dec (dec.Denv n) := rfl
